_note: Interest the Central Government adds to a refund, 0.5 % for every month or part of a month: on a refund out of tax at source or advance tax from 1 April after the tax year (from furnishing where the return was late), on one out of tax paid on the return from furnishing or payment, whichever is later, each to the refund's grant; none where the refund is less than 10 % of the tax as determined. 1961 s.244A(1)(a), (aa) and proviso read the same; the amending Acts 2019 – 2026 touch only its provisos on orders (FA 2023 s.98, F(No. 2)A 2024 s.72). Sources: plans/W-112b.md; D-663.
